source_title: Punjab Assembly polls 2027: AAP announces first list of 40 candidates
source_excerpt: New Delhi Taking the lead in announcing candidates for the Punjab Assembly election, due in early 2027, the ruling Aam Aadmi Party (AAP) on Saturday (October 31, 2026) released its list of 40 candidates, all of them sitting legislators. Chief Minister Bhagwant Mann will re-contest from the Dhuri Assembly constituency in Sangrur district. https://www.thehindu.com/news/national/punjab/bjps-way-of-working-ahead-of-elections-bhagwant-mann-on-cbi-raids/article71555152.ece Congress hopes for calm in Punjab unit but storm clouds remain ahead of 2027 Assembly election Congress hopes for calm in Punjab unit but storm clouds remain ahead of 2027 Assembly election News Analysis Congress hopes for calm in Punjab unit but storm clouds remain ahead of 2027 Assembly election storyline 1 There are 117 Assembly seats in Punjab and the five-year term of the Assembly ends on March 16, 2027. The AAP registered a landslide victory in the 2022 Assembly election by winning 92 seats. Among prominent candidates, the Punjab Assembly Speaker Kultar Singh Sandhwan will contest from Kotkapura, while Minister Sanjeev Arora, currently in jail in an alleged money laundering case, is the party’s candidate from Ludhiana West. Others include Kuldeep Singh Dhaliwal from Ajnala, Inderbir Singh Nijjar from Amritsar South, Kulwant Singh from SAS Nagar, and Bram Shanker Sharma Jimpa from Hoshiarpur constituency. ਆਮ ਆਦਮੀ ਪਾਰਟੀ ਵੱਲੋਂ 2027 ਦੀਆਂ ਵਿਧਾਨ ਸਭਾ ਚੋਣਾਂ ਲਈ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰਾਂ ਦੀ ਪਹਿਲੀ ਸੂਚੀ ਦਾ ਐਲਾਨ। ਸਾਰੇ ਉਮੀਦਵਾਰਾਂ ਨੂੰ ਬਹੁਤ-ਬਹੁਤ ਸ਼ੁਭਕਾਮਨਾਵਾਂ https://t.co/Jcfn6BDnGN— AAP Punjab (@AAPPunjab) October 31, 2026 Mr. Mann told media persons that in a meeting of the party’s political affairs committee, a detailed discussion had taken place on candidate selection. “Based on surveys, and according to a survey of the public, candidates who received a positive response were considered. Forty tickets have been finalised,” the CM said. “New faces will also get a chance. ​Our party’s principle is that, three or four months before Assembly elections are held, we release the list of candidates. Candidates will get the opportunity to go to the people and take the government’s work to them,” Mr. Mann said.
